resources.name: Andromeda Community Initiative
resources.mission: Andromeda Community Initiative [ACI] is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization that provides professional development opportunities, free educational and workforce development programs, and job-related training that prepares students for gainful employment in the field of construction. By providing quality training imparted by credentialed subject matter experts, ACI bridges the gap between companies in need of qualified workers and individuals seeking quality career ladder employment. Visit tinyurl.com/yvv6yvxh

resources.name: EarSay, Inc
resources.mission: EarSay is an artist-driven non-profit arts organization dedicated to nurturing and portraying stories of the uncelebrated. Our projects bridge the divide between documentary and expressive forms in books, exhibitions, on stage, in sound & electronic media. We are committed to fostering understanding across all cultures and generations through artistic productions and education. We bring our work to theaters, museums, schools, festivals, and universities.

resources.name: Hidden Halos Kingdom Assets, Inc.
resources.mission: The mission of Hidden Halos Kingdom Assets is to alleviate poverty and enhance quality of life by addressing socio-economic needs through strategic partnerships and community-focused initiatives, both locally and globally.
resources.languages: English, Haitian Kreyol, French and Spanish

resources.name: LIC Community Boathouse
resources.mission: LICCB connects Queens residents with their waterfront and waterways. We advocate for cleaner water and more and better access to it. Please volunteer, donate, and participate.

resources.name: New York Irish Center
resources.address: 1040 Jackson Avenue, Long Island City, NY 11101
resources.mission: The New York Irish Center's mission is to share Ireland's culture and foster collaboration between people of all heritages through social services, cultural and educational programs. The center provides free daily programs for seniors.
resources.social: Instagram: @nyirishcenter; Facebook: @New York Irish Center; TikTok: @nyirishcenter; Twitter/X: @NYIrishCenter

resources.name: Solace House Inc.
resources.address: 10-40 Jackson Avenue, Long Island City, NY 11101
resources.mission: Solace House provides free, barrier-free mental health counseling and suicide prevention services to individuals and families in need. We offer a safe, non-judgmental space for those in crisis or struggling with emotional distress, ensuring compassionate, immediate, and professional support without any cost or access limitations. Our mission is to foster hope, healing, and resilience within our community while working to break the stigma around mental health. All services are free for those 18+ residing in NY statewide, confidential, and available without barriers to access.
resources.languages: English; Spanish available via translation technology upon request

resources.name: Thalia Spanish Theatre Inc.
resources.mission: Thalia Spanish Theatre is the only bilingual Hispanic theatre in Queens, serving one of the most diverse communities in the U.S., including over ONE MILLION Hispanics. For over four decades Thalia has been committed to creating programming that creates opportunities for Hispanic artists, is relevant to its constituency and brings diverse audiences together. The organization's goals are to: create new work by Hispanic playwrights, composers, directors, and choreographers; promote intercultural understanding by presenting a positive image of Hispanic culture and people; provide a vital cultural link to the thousands of Hispanic immigrants in New York; produce work and employ artists that reflect the diversity of New York City's Hispanic community; and empower Hispanic artists.
resources.fees: Yes, tickets for our mainstage shows range from $35-$50.
